theme_central: The Messenger sent among an unlettered people to purify hearts and teach wisdom — hence the institution of the Friday prayer, which gives the surah its name.

branches.title: The Messenger sent among the unlettered
branches.resume: Everything glorifies Allah; Messenger sent to purify hearts and teach the Book.

children.t: Messenger sent among the unlettered to purify hearts

branches.title: The Torah left unapplied
branches.resume: Parable of the donkey carrying books; challenge issued to those who claim to be Allah's chosen people.

children.t: Parable of the donkey carrying books, challenge over the claim of chosen people

branches.title: The Friday prayer
branches.resume: Leaving trade at the call to prayer, dispersing afterward to seek Allah's favor.
